heading: Caught on camera: Speeding Thar rams into scooter, 57-year-old dies
author: Edited by: Anjali Singh / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Updated: Sep 21, 2026, 20:56 IST
paragraphs: JAIPUR: A 57-year-old dairy operator was killed after his scooter was allegedly hit from behind by a speeding SUV in Jaipur's Sanganer area, police said on Monday.The accident took place on Saturday morning, while CCTV footage of the incident surfaced on Monday, police said.The deceased was identified as Naval Sharma, a resident of Buddhsinghpura in Sanganer.According to police, Sharma had left his home on his scooter around 6 am on Saturday to go to his dairy when a Mahindra Thar allegedly hit him from behind
The driver fled the spot after the accident, they said.Passersby informed the police, following which Sharma was taken to a hospital
